idea-plugin.name: Docstring Freshness Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Docstring Freshness Monitor

Outdated documentation is worse than no documentation. Docstring Freshness Monitor uses Git history to compare when code was last changed versus when its documentation was last updated — giving every docstring a freshness score from 0 to 100.

Key Features

  • Freshness Scoring (0–100) — Quantified metric based on code-to-doc change ratio
  • Stale Doc Inspection — IDE warnings with configurable severity for outdated docstrings
  • Multi-Language Support — Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Git-Powered Analysis — Compares commit timestamps of code blocks and their docstrings
  • Quick Actions — Mark docs as reviewed or jump to the code change that made them stale

Why Docstring Freshness Monitor?

Misleading documentation causes bugs. This plugin automatically identifies docs that haven't kept pace with code changes, so your team can prioritize documentation updates where they matter most.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Freshness inspection, stale doc warnings, multi-language support
  • Pro: Project-wide freshness dashboard with per-file scores, trend tracking, team freshness reports, and integration with documentation generators
